In turn 4 the expressions remark is not a place to look. It puts forward expressions as a candidate cause, which is a guess at why Stamp jumped, and the check gave no such cause.
Turn 4 says what is off and where ("Stamp ... 120 px to the left of where it was at 0 s"), points to Edit > Undo, and neither re-parents Stamp nor offers to.

Every layer, null, distance and time named (Tile, Caption, Stamp, Null 1, 120 px, 0 s) appears in the tool results, and the interface names (Parent column, pick whip, Edit > Undo) are plausible and used as the skill's steps say.
